sections.title: Text 1

blocks.zh: 六一儿童节，刘明、王一雪带刘小明到北京野生动物园看动物，他们先坐车进入猛兽区。
blocks.en: On Children’s Day, Liu Ming and Wang Yixue take Liu Xiaoming to Beijing Wildlife Park. They first ride into the predator area.

blocks.zh: 刘小明：爸爸、妈妈，快看，熊和老虎都在这儿呢！
blocks.en: Xiaoming: Dad, Mum, look! The bears and tigers are all here!

blocks.zh: 王一雪：小明，注意安全，不要一直大喊！
blocks.en: Wang: Xiaoming, be careful and stop shouting all the time!

blocks.zh: 刘明：你们看，那个叫东北虎，是国家一级保护动物。那边树林里还有很多动物呢。
blocks.en: Liu: Look, that is a Siberian tiger, a nationally protected first-class animal. There are many more animals in those woods.

blocks.zh: 刘小明：咱们都能看到吧？
blocks.en: Xiaoming: We can see all of them, right?

blocks.zh: 王一雪：对。景区的车每到一个动物区都会停一会儿，让人们能近距离看看这些动物。
blocks.en: Wang: Yes. The park vehicle stops at each animal area so people can see the animals up close.

blocks.zh: 刘明：真不错，这景区真大、真美！我知道北京野生动物园很大，可怎么也没想到这么大！
blocks.en: Liu: Wonderful! This park is huge and beautiful. I knew Beijing Wildlife Park was large, but I never imagined it was this large!

blocks.zh: 王一雪：这里有几千只动物呢，能不大吗？现在是节假日，人多。小明，一会儿千万别跑丢了，我可不是开玩笑呢。
blocks.en: Wang: There are thousands of animals here; how could it be small? It is a holiday and crowded. Xiaoming, be sure not to run off and get lost. I am not joking.

blocks.zh: 小明在北京野生动物园里先看到了什么动物？
blocks.en: Which animals did Xiaoming first see at Beijing Wildlife Park?

answers.en: He first saw bears and tigers.

blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

blocks.zh: 北京野生动物园有多少只动物？
blocks.en: How many animals does Beijing Wildlife Park have?

answers.en: There are several thousand animals.

blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

sections.note: Retell this text in your own words

prompt.zh: 六一儿童节，刘明、王一雪带儿子刘小明到北京野生动物园游玩。在动物园里，小明兴奋地喊着：“爸爸、妈妈，快看，……！”王一雪让他注意安全，……。刘明说，他们看到的老虎叫……，是国家……。刘明还说，那边树林里……。小明很想看到那些动物，王一雪告诉他，景区的车……都会停一会儿，让人们能近距离……。北京野生动物园很大，刘明说他怎么也没……。王一雪说，这里有……呢。同时，王一雪也提醒小明，节假日人多，千万……。
prompt.en: On Children’s Day the family visits the wildlife park. Xiaoming shouts, “Look, …!” His mother asks him to be careful and…. His father identifies the tiger as…and nationally…. More animals are…. The vehicle stops…so visitors can…. Liu never imagined…. There are…. During the crowded holiday, Xiaoming must not….

answer.zh: 六一儿童节，刘明和王一雪带小明到动物园。小明看到熊和老虎，大声喊了起来。王一雪让他注意安全，不要一直大喊。刘明说那是东北虎，是国家一级保护动物，树林里还有很多动物。景区的车到每个动物区都会停，让大家近距离看动物。这里有几千只动物，又大又美，刘明怎么也没想到这么大。王一雪提醒小明千万别跑丢了。
answer.en: The family visits the zoo on Children’s Day. Xiaoming shouts when he sees bears and tigers. His mother asks him to be careful and stop shouting. His father identifies the nationally protected Siberian tiger and points out other animals. The vehicle stops at each area for a close look. Thousands of animals live in the unexpectedly large, beautiful park. His mother reminds him not to get lost.

sections.title: Text 2

blocks.zh: 在王一飞家，王一飞夫妇邀请白家月、安妮和陈天中过中秋节。
blocks.en: At Wang Yifei’s home, she and her husband host Bai Jiayue, Annie and Chen Tianzhong for Mid-Autumn Festival.

blocks.zh: 王一飞：来，大家快吃月饼，这儿还有葡萄、西瓜。
blocks.en: Wang: Come and have mooncakes, everyone. There are also grapes and watermelon.

blocks.zh: 杨同乐：这是今年的新茶，你们也尝尝。
blocks.en: Yang: This is this year’s fresh tea. Try some too.

blocks.zh: 陈天中：好的。这茶闻着真香！
blocks.en: Chen: All right. This tea smells wonderful!

blocks.zh: 白家月：我还是第一次在中国过中秋节呢。
blocks.en: Bai: This is my first Mid-Autumn Festival in China.

blocks.zh: 安妮：我在加拿大时和中国朋友一起过过中秋节。我记得那天，外面的街道、剧院有很多演出活动。
blocks.en: Annie: I celebrated it with Chinese friends in Canada. I remember many performances on the streets and in theatres that day.

blocks.zh: 王一飞：在中国，每年中秋节都会举办很多活动，而且这几年一年比一年热闹。对了，家月，今天是李文爷爷的生日，李文来不了了，你就多吃一块月饼吧。
blocks.en: Wang: China holds many Mid-Autumn events, and they get livelier each year. Jiayue, it is Li Wen’s grandfather’s birthday today, so Li cannot come. Have an extra mooncake!

blocks.zh: 白家月：谢谢，那我就不客气了。
blocks.en: Bai: Thanks, I will!

blocks.zh: 杨同乐：中秋节和生日赶在了一块儿，真巧、真好！中秋节多陪陪家人也是应该的。
blocks.en: Yang: The festival and birthday coincide—what a lovely coincidence! It is right to spend more time with family at Mid-Autumn Festival.

blocks.zh: 白家月以前在中国过过中秋节吗？
blocks.en: Has Bai celebrated Mid-Autumn Festival in China before?

answers.zh: 没有，这是她第一次在中国过中秋节。
answers.en: No, this is her first time celebrating it in China.

blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

blocks.zh: 在加拿大，安妮和中国朋友过中秋节时那里有什么活动？
blocks.en: What activities were held when Annie celebrated with Chinese friends in Canada?

sections.title: Text 3

blocks.zh: 中秋节的“反向团圆”
blocks.en: The Mid-Autumn “Reverse Reunion”

blocks.zh: 中秋节时中国人一般都会回家过节。但是有些人由于工作需要，不能回家，只能一个人留在工作的地方过节。周力就是这些人之中的一位。他是一名铁路工作人员，今年中秋假期，要负责铁路安全检查。
blocks.en: Chinese people generally go home for Mid-Autumn Festival. Some must remain where they work because of their duties. Zhou Li is one of them. He is a railway employee responsible for railway safety inspections during this year’s holiday.

blocks.zh: 周力的父母知道儿子这次不能回家后，就决定来一次“反向团圆”。早上五点左右他们就坐上了高铁，大约七点就来到了儿子工作的城市。在儿子家，他们做了一桌儿子爱吃的饭菜，有烤肉、烤鱼、饺子等等，还有西红柿鸡蛋汤。周力下班回家，看到一桌子饭菜和突然出现的父母，他感觉特别幸福。
blocks.en: When his parents learned he could not come home, they decided on a “reverse reunion.” They boarded a high-speed train at around five in the morning and arrived in his city at about seven. At his home they cooked his favourite roast meat, roast fish, dumplings and tomato-and-egg soup. Returning from work to see the food and his unexpectedly present parents, Zhou felt especially happy.

blocks.zh: 这个中秋节，地点变了，但爱没变。
blocks.en: This Mid-Autumn Festival, the place changed, but the love did not.

blocks.zh: “反向团圆”是什么意思？
blocks.en: What does “reverse reunion” mean?

answers.zh: 孩子不能回家，父母就去孩子工作的地方团圆。
answers.en: When children cannot come home, parents visit where they work to reunite.

answers.zh: 因为父母来到他家，还做了一桌他爱吃的饭菜。
answers.en: His parents came to his home and prepared his favourite dishes.

prompt.zh:
中秋节时中国人一般都……。但是有些人由于……，不能回家，只能一个人……过节。周力就是……。他是……，今年中秋假期，要负责……。
周力的父母知道周力……后，就决定来一次……。早上五点左右他们就……，大约七点就来到了……。在儿子家，他们做了一桌……，有……等等，还有……。周力下班回家，看到……，他感觉特别幸福。
这个中秋节，地点……，但……。
prompt.en: At Mid-Autumn Festival Chinese people usually…. Some cannot return because of…and remain…. Zhou is…. He works as…and is responsible for…. His parents learn…and decide…. At around five they…and around seven arrive…. They cook…, including…and…. Seeing…, he feels happy. The place…, but….

answer.zh: 中秋节时，中国人一般会回家过节。周力是铁路工作人员，因为要检查铁路安全，不能回家。父母决定去他工作的地方“反向团圆”。他们五点左右坐高铁，大约七点到达，给儿子做了烤肉、烤鱼、饺子和西红柿鸡蛋汤。周力下班回家，看到父母和一桌饭菜，非常幸福。这个中秋节，地点变了，但爱没变。
answer.en: People usually return home for Mid-Autumn Festival, but railway employee Zhou must inspect railway safety. His parents travel to him for a reverse reunion, taking the train around five and arriving about seven. They cook roast meat, fish, dumplings and tomato-and-egg soup. He feels very happy to find them and the food at home. The place changed, but the love did not.

sections.title: Text 4

blocks.zh: 节日的美好记忆
blocks.en: Wonderful Memories of Festivals

blocks.zh: 中国有很多节日，比如春节、元宵节、端午节、中秋节等。
blocks.en: China has many festivals, including Spring Festival, Lantern Festival, Dragon Boat Festival and Mid-Autumn Festival.

blocks.zh: 作为一年里最重要的传统节日，春节对中国人来说有着特别的意义。春节到来时，人们不管在哪里，都想回家过年。春节前也最忙，既要收拾房子、打扫卫生，又要准备各种美食。除夕这天晚上，一家人一边吃年夜饭，一边看春晚。零点一到，大家互相祝新年快乐，到处都是幸福的笑声。
blocks.en: As the year’s most important traditional festival, Spring Festival has special meaning for Chinese people. Wherever they are, people want to go home. Beforehand they are busy tidying and cleaning their homes and preparing delicious food. On New Year’s Eve, the family eats dinner while watching the Spring Festival Gala. At midnight everyone exchanges New Year greetings amid happy laughter.

blocks.zh: 每当回忆起童年，我最美好的记忆很多也发生在过年时。虽然现在已人到中年，离开了家，但是春节仍然是我最喜欢的节日，过年时也更想父母、兄弟姐妹。
blocks.en: When I recall childhood, many of my happiest memories are of New Year. Although I am now middle-aged and have left home, Spring Festival remains my favourite festival, when I miss my parents and siblings even more.

blocks.zh: 为什么说春节对中国人来说有着特别的意义？
blocks.en: Why does Spring Festival have special meaning for Chinese people?

answers.zh: 因为它是一年里最重要的传统节日，大家都想回家和家人一起过年。
answers.en: It is the most important traditional festival, when everyone wants to celebrate with family at home.

answers.zh: 因为他很多美好的童年记忆都发生在过年时。
answers.en: Many of his happiest childhood memories are of New Year.

blocks.heading: Group discussion

blocks.zh: 在你的国家，你最喜欢过什么节？请写一篇短文，说说过节时发生的故事，不少于140字。
blocks.en: Which festival in your country do you most enjoy? Write at least 140 Chinese characters telling a story from that festival.

answers.zh: 我最喜欢春节，因为过年时一家人能在一起。去年春节，我和父母一起回老家。我们大约下午三点到，爷爷、奶奶已在门口等我们了。我帮奶奶准备年夜饭，父亲打扫房间，母亲和爷爷聊天儿。六点左右，大家坐下来吃饭。我怎么也没想到，奶奶做了这么多我爱吃的菜！饭后，我们一起看电视，说起我童年时的事情，大家都笑了。虽然平时工作很忙，很难见面，但是春节让我们有机会团圆。作为家里的一员，我希望以后每年都能回家，多陪陪父母和爷爷、奶奶。这是我最美好的记忆之一。
answers.en: Spring Festival is my favourite because the family can reunite. Last year we reached our hometown around three, where my grandparents were waiting. I helped prepare dinner, Dad cleaned, and Mum chatted with Grandpa. At around six we ate; I was amazed by all my favourite dishes. Later we watched television and laughed about my childhood. Although work makes it hard to meet, the festival brings us together. I hope to return every year and spend more time with my family. This is one of my happiest memories.
